content: This paper presents a novel methodology for jointly performing feature selection and classification of functional data with categorical responses, addressing high-dimensional scenarios by integrating logistic loss and functional features. The proposed approach employs functional principal components and an adaptive Dual Augmented Lagrangian algorithm to efficiently identify crucial features, and its effectiveness is demonstrated through simulations and a real-world analysis of chronic diseases and health factors.
